d:
"Nazar Teri Toofan" is a captivating romantic love song from the movie "Merry Christmas," starring Katrina Kaif and Vijay Sethupathi. The enchanting music is composed by Pritam, while the soulful vocals are rendered by Raghav Chaitanya. The heartfelt lyrics by Varun Grover beautifully express the intensity and passion of love
Song Credits:
Song: Nazar Teri Toofan(Version 2)
Movie: Merry Christmas
Singer: Raghav Chaitanya
Lyrics: Varun Grover
Music Director: Pritam
